Name: Kingdom Hearts Hairstyles
Author: AiyexAyen
Description:
[size=3][b]Kingdom Hearts Hairstyles[/b] is a content pack for Content Patcher. It replaces several of the base game hairstyles with colourable Kingdom Hearts characters' hairstyles.[/size]


[size=4][u][b]Notes

[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*]All hairstyles are available from game start in both the new character creation menu and in the appearance changer menu in the Wizard's room.
[*]Kingdom Hearts Hairstyles is compatible with any mod that does not alter the base hairstyles file of the game.
[*]Check out my mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21334]Kingdom Hearts Shirts[/url]﻿ that go with the hairstyles for the full cosplay experience.
[/list]

[size=4][u][b]How To Use:[/b][/u][/size]

1. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ is installed and updated to the latest version.
2. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is installed and updated to the latest version.
3. Download the Kingdom Hearts Hairstyles .zip file.
4. Unzip and add folder to your Mods folder.
5. Run the game and find the hairstyles when you create a new character or alter your character's appearance in the Wizard's room.
